title: dprint configuration file
description: Schema for a dprint configuration file.

$schema.description: The JSON schema reference. Normally you shouldn't bother to provide this as the dprint vscode editor extension will handle constructing the schema for you based on the plugins provided.

incremental.description: Whether to format files only when they change.

inherit.description: For a nested (directory specific) configuration file, whether to inherit the plugins and configuration of the ancestor configuration file. Has no effect on a root configuration file.

anyOf.description: A file path or url to a configuration file to extend.
A collection of file paths and/or urls to configuration files to extend.

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the printer will try to stay under. Note that the printer may exceed this width in certain cases.

indentWidth.description: The number of characters for an indent.

useTabs.description: Whether to use tabs (true) or spaces (false) for indentation.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

includes.description: Array of patterns (globs) to use to find files to format.

excludes.description: Array of patterns (globs) to exclude files or directories to format.

additionalProperties.description: The file extension to treat matching files as (ex. "sh" or ".sh").

shebangs.description: Maps a shebang line (ex. "#!/usr/bin/env bash") to a file extension so extensionless scripts can be routed to a plugin.

plugins.description: Array of plugin URLs to format files.

locked.description: Whether this plugin configuration is locked against overrides from extending configurations.

associations.description: File patterns to associate with this plugin, in addition to the file extensions and file names it matches by default. Use a negated glob (ex. "!**/*.js") to stop matching a default extension or file name.

anyOf.description: Overrides of a plugin's configuration, one or more.

overrides.description: Plugin configuration overrides for specific file patterns.

files.description: File patterns this override applies to.

pluginOverride.description: An override of a plugin's configuration for some of its files.
